L1.rule: min(wall thickness, max(2 pixels, half wall thickness)); scale alone if thickness unknown

meaning: Review only; no geometry changed. Align to an existing line, never an average. Real setbacks, voids and narrow spaces require evidence; do not delete partitions or alter connectivity.

wall_placement.tolerance_source: max(2 cm, four original pixels): two endpoint picks at two pixels each
wall_placement.scope: Explicit saved annotation spans relative to their named reference wall; not all walls, drawing truth or an automatic repair.
wall_placement.reason: No usable structured wall annotations; prose, ink measurements and absent records are not checks.
